ruleDefinitions.name: Compressed File Extraction Via Tar.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects execution of "tar.exe" in order to extract compressed file.
Adversaries may abuse various utilities in order to decompress data to avoid detection.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\tar\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "bsdtar") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-x.*"))
